latestVersion.changelog:
- Initial release of Image to Video No Limits (v1.0.0).
- Convert JPG, PNG, WEBP, or HEIC images (up to 200MB) into 1080p MP4 videos, with no restrictions on style or length.
- Simple user workflow: upload images, describe desired video, and receive a rendered MP4 in 30–90 seconds.
- Session and authorization handled automatically; 100 free credits with instant, anonymous token setup.
- Includes support for video editing features, text overlays, audio tracks, and downloadable exports.
- Provides clear error handling, progress updates, and usage tips for best results.
